Doctor Bek – Equine Chiropractor, Equestrian, and Founder of Moment of Suspension Podcast.

Dr. Rebekah "Doctor Bek" Jarzombek is the founder and CEO of Giddy Up Chiropractic in San Diego, working with performance horses while teaching nervous system regulation and leadership.

Through her work with horses and people, she explores the moments in life that feel like the "in-between place" and involve faith, timing, and alignment – bringing real-world experience into conversations that challenge how we navigate pressure, growth, and purpose.
